events.title: On Holding (ONON) Tops Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: On Holding (ONON) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +32.77% and +0.86%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
